name: proofpay-monorepo
description: Non-custodial milestone escrow and cross-chain payout protocol for NEAR.

scripts.build: pnpm -r --if-present build && cargo build --manifest-path contracts/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release
scripts.test:demo: if [ -f "$HOME/.cargo/env" ]; then . "$HOME/.cargo/env"; fi && pnpm test && node scripts/test-demo.mjs && pnpm --filter @proofpay/agent-verifier exec tsx ../scripts/test-reproducibility.ts && node scripts/testnet-smoke.mjs && if grep -q '^NEAR_VERIFIER_PRIVATE_KEY=.' agent-verifier/.env 2>/dev/null; then (cd agent-verifier && set -a && . ./.env && set +a && npm run verify:key-permissions); else echo '[SKIP] Live Function-Call negative test requires agent-verifier/.env credentials.'; fi && npm run zip
